mentions.name: peppy.bot
mentions.description: A robotics framework positioned as a replacement for ROS 2. It is currently gaining automatic node resolution so that pulling working software for a robot becomes as simple as running an install command like `apt get install my_robot`. Its goal is to let developers from different specialties (embedded developers, AI engineers, vibe coders) each work on their own part of the robot stack without having to worry about the other parts.
mentions.problem: Developers working on robots have to worry about parts of the robot stack outside their own specialty, and ROS 2 is the incumbent framework being replaced.
mentions.audience: Developers from all fields, including embedded developers, AI engineers, and vibe coders
mentions.source_excerpt: https://peppy.bot a robotics framework to replace ROS 2, currently working on automatic nodes resolution so pulling a working software for your robot is as easy as doing an `apt get install my_robot`.
